home.title: Bento Platform
home.tagline: An open-source web platform to explore and share clinical and -omics data.
home.heroImageAlt: Preview of the Bento data catalogue: a search box, a study card, and summary counts of studies, specimens and participants.
home.introHeading: One platform, built for genomics data
home.intro1: A recurrent need for projects in genomics revolves around the implementation, deployment and maintenance of a platform to organize their datasets. The requirements are essentially the same: standardize, ingest, allow querying and retrieval of clinical, experiments and multi-omics data.
home.intro2: The Bento platform has been created as a reusable solution to address these common needs. It aims to follow as closely as possible international data standards, such as those within <ga4gh>GA4GH</ga4gh>, to unlock the potential of sharing data alongside other initiatives.
home.intro3: A Bento platform node is composed of many services that each accomplish a specific task. Some components can be brought in, or left out, depending on the needs of the project leveraging it.
home.exploreDescription: Learn what Bento sets out to do, what it can already do, and where it's headed next.
home.goalsCardDescription: The principles Bento is designed around, from data standards to deployment.
home.featuresCardDescription: A look at the public dashboard, authenticated portal, and Beacon API.
home.releasesCardDescription: Version history and what shipped in each Bento release.
